name: Helix DS
description: Helix DS tokens: the base set (tokens.json, light) and the theme modifier, whose dark context replaces the tokens in tokens.dark.json. Any DTCG 2025.10 tool resolves Helix's light and dark themes from this file; packages/tokens/src/build.ts does the same to write dist/helix.css.

helix.description: Every Helix token — primitive, semantic and component — with its light value.

theme.description: Color theme. Light is tokens.json as is; dark replaces the tokens in tokens.dark.json, and every token aliasing one of them follows it.
